decision.reason: The original Fib1.272 continuation rates (65.2% / 80.3% / 89.9%) are not used as independent quality evidence because the target distance shrinks mechanically with r. After controlling the common normalized distance, H1-extension medians are 1.516R / 2.185R / 2.110R, and HURDLE_0272 success is 87.2% / 88.0% / 91.7%; HURDLE_0618 success is 73.0% / 79.8% / 80.2%. These descriptive geometry-controlled results do not show weaker post-confirmation continuation for deep Wave2, conditional on having reached CONFIRMED. The fixed 81-event Fib-near sample remains 64/81 strict post-T Fib1.272 successes, including 55 VERY_DEEP, but confirmed-only outcomes do not prove pre-confirmation early-entry effectiveness. They support prioritizing a separate PRE-CONFIRMATION causal study as a research hypothesis, not deleting deep Wave2 contexts. At the same time, existing T-day gates already exclude all 217 VERY_DEEP events from ENTRY_ALLOWED in this development funnel, so a new depth gate would be redundant here; no production change is authorized by this result.
decision.production_change: none; requires a separately approved causal research protocol
